_comment: HAND-AUTHORED. Never script-written. A bank of PRE-APPROVED positioning lines that sit
under the name on the one-pager.
This file exists so a tailored CV SELECTS a tagline by id — it never writes a fresh one.
A positioning line is the easiest place for a generated CV to drift into a claim the data
cannot support, so the wording is fixed here, by hand, in advance. Every option below must
be defensible from data/experience.json + cv/publications.bib alone.
`default: null` means the untailored ONE-PAGE.tex renders no tagline, exactly as before.
Referenced as `tagline:<id>` from an application manifest.
